Name: Truffle Foxes - Void Edition
Author: Nom0ri
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][b][center]If you've seen PlatinumCats Truffle Foxes, this mod might seem familiar...
just with a bit of extra spite and grumpiness mixed in.[/center][/b][/size][/font][center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/V6tL5HpS/Cursed-fox-gif.gif[/img]﻿[/center]

[b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][Features]
[/size][/font][/b][list]
[*]Grumpy foxes with custom sounds, descriptions and icons
[*]Special Order from our friendly Sewer dweller
[*]Unique produce
[*]Void Truffles can be made into Void Oil in the Oil Maker - both of these are slightly more valuable than their vanilla counterparts... might have a weird taste tho
[/list]

[b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][Unlock Conditions]
[/size][/font][/b]
There are 2 options for unlocking the grumps, you can choose which one fits you best in the config:

[Default]: After meeting Krobus, a special order from him may appear on the board. Completing it requires access to the Witch's Swamp.
[Easy]: All you need is Deluxe Barn.


[b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][Config][/size][/font][/b]
[list]
[*]Unique Produce [i](true|false)[/i] - Choose if you want Void Foxes to have unique products to dig up. Otherwise they dig up regular truffles. [i][default: true][/i]
[*]Easy Unlock [i](true|false)[/i] - See [Unlock Conditions] above. [i][default: false][/i]
[/list]

[b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][Compatibility][/size][/font][/b]
The mod add completely new custom animals and doesn't replace any of the existing ones, which means it should be fully compatible with anything. Yes, that includes the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32004]Truffle Foxes[/url], which I can highly recommed using alongside this mod for full fox immersion.


[b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][Credits][/size][/font][/b]
